title: api: introduce schema versioning headers, deprecation warnings, and OpenAI-compat backcompat shims
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We need a predictable way to evolve request/response shapes across Redwood and the OpenAI-compatibility surface without breaking existing customers. This PR introduces an explicit API schema versioning header, emits deprecation warnings for soon-to-be-removed fields, and implements a set of backward-compatibility shims to accept/translate older OpenAI-compat request patterns (functions vs tools, json_schema vs structured_output, legacy streaming chunk shapes). Changes: 1) New header parsing: requests can opt-in or pin a schema via X-Redwood-API-Version or Prefer: respond-version=<semver>. Default remains v1; a beta channel (v1-beta) is available. 2) Deprecation warnings: server now emits X-Redwood-Deprecation and Warning headers when deprecated fields are used; messages include removal ETA and migration hints. 3) OpenAI compatibility shims: the OpenAI adapter accepts legacy 'functions' naming and maps it to our internal 'tools' model; accepts both 'json_schema' and the newer 'structured_output' and normalizes on input and output. 4) Streaming stability: unify SSE chunk envelope to include a 'schemaVersion' field and normalize final "done" frames across legacy clients to avoid double-EOF races; improves framing robustness and adds e2e tests for flaky network reconnection scenarios. 5) Docs and dev-experience: update API docs with version header examples, add migration guide, and add a deprecation timeline table. Backwards compatibility approach: we prefer runtime shims that translate older shapes into the canonical server schema, and we surface deprecation headers (and logs) to give users time to migrate. We also added feature gates so older deployments in Dedicated/Private can opt out of the beta header behavior until they upgrade. Testing: unit tests for header parsing and shim translations, e2e streaming tests that reproduce previously reported races, and integration tests against the OpenAI-compat adapter. CI: all checks pass after fixing a flaky SSE test. Rollout: merged to main; will be behind a feature flag for Dedicated/Private by default for the next two weeks, then enabled globally with opt-out for customers that need longer migrations.
commits: feat(api): parse X-Redwood-API-Version and Prefer respond-version header
feat(compat): add OpenAI adapter shims for functions->tools and json_schema->structured_output
fix(streaming): stabilize SSE framing and add schemaVersion to chunks
chore(tests): add e2e streaming reconnection tests
docs: add versioning and deprecation migration guide

release_notes: - Introduces API schema versioning via X-Redwood-API-Version and Prefer: respond-version headers; default v1 remains. - Emits X-Redwood-Deprecation and Warning headers when deprecated fields are used; deprecation ETA = 90 days. - Adds runtime shims to maintain OpenAI-compatibility: functions -> tools, json_schema -> structured_output, legacy streaming frames normalized. - Streaming stability improvements to SSE framing and reconnection handling. - Docs: migration guide and examples; SDK follow-ups scheduled (ENG-918).
